经过: 越王勾践围吴三年，夫差自杀，吴亡。
text_en: Goujian, king of Yue, besieges Wu for three years; Fuchai kills himself and Wu falls.

经过: 秦厉共公伐大荔，取其王城。
text_en: Duke Ligong of Qin attacks the Dali Rong and takes Dali Wangcheng.

经过: 楚惠王灭蔡。
text_en: King Hui of Chu destroys Cai.

经过: 楚惠王灭杞。
text_en: King Hui of Chu destroys Qi.

经过: 楚简王灭莒。
text_en: King Jian of Chu destroys Ju.

经过: 越王朱句灭郯（约前414，据《竹书纪年》）。
text_en: Zhugou, king of Yue, destroys Tan (c. 414 BC, according to the Bamboo Annals).

经过: 魏文侯使乐羊伐中山，三年而拔之（约前380 中山复国）。
text_en: Marquis Wen of Wei sends Yue Yang against Zhongshan, which falls after three years (it is restored around 380 BC).

经过: 许约在战国初灭亡，或说灭于楚、或说灭于魏，年代不详（图上示意）。
text_en: Xu falls around the beginning of the Warring States, by one view to Chu, by another to Wei; the date is unknown (shown schematically on the map).

经过: 魏、韩、赵废晋静公为家人，三分其余地，晋绝祀（一说前349）。
text_en: Wei, Han and Zhao depose Duke Jing of Jin, making him a commoner, and divide the rest of his land in three; the sacrifices of Jin come to an end (one view: 349 BC).

经过: 韩哀侯灭郑，迁都新郑。
text_en: Marquis Ai of Han destroys Zheng and moves his capital to Xinzheng.

经过: 随（曾）约在前4世纪中叶并入楚，年代不详（图上示意）。
text_en: Sui (Zeng) is absorbed into Chu around the middle of the 4th century BC; the date is unknown (shown schematically on the map).

经过: 蜀伐苴，苴侯奔巴求救于秦；秦司马错、张仪灭蜀，遂取苴与巴。
title_en: Fall of Ba, Shu and Ju
text_en: Shu attacks Ju; the marquis of Ju flees to Ba and appeals to Qin; Sima Cuo and Zhang Yi of Qin destroy Shu and go on to take Ju and Ba.

经过: 楚怀王乘越内乱灭越，杀越王无疆，尽取故吴地至浙江，置江东郡（杨宽说；传统据《史记》作前334/前333 楚威王时）。
text_en: King Huai of Chu destroys Yue in its internal turmoil, kills Wujiang, king of Yue, takes all the old lands of Wu up to the Zhe River and sets up Jiangdong Commandery (Yang Kuan's view; tradition, following the Shiji, dates it to King Wei of Chu in 334/333 BC).

经过: 赵武灵王灭中山。
text_en: King Wuling of Zhao destroys Zhongshan.

经过: 齐湣王灭宋。
text_en: King Min of Qi destroys Song.

经过: 秦宣太后诱杀义渠王，秦灭义渠。
text_en: Queen Dowager Xuan of Qin lures the king of Yiqu to his death, and Qin destroys Yiqu.

经过: 秦灭西周，周赧王卒；楚取鲁（前255 封鲁君于莒，前249 灭鲁）。
title_en: Fall of West Zhou and Lu
text_en: Qin destroys West Zhou and King Nan of Zhou dies; Chu takes Lu (in 255 BC it enfeoffs the lord of Lu at Ju, and destroys Lu in 249 BC).

经过: 秦相吕不韦灭东周。
text_en: The Qin chancellor Lü Buwei destroys East Zhou.

经过: 内史腾虏韩王安，置颍川郡。
text_en: The Neishi Teng captures An, king of Han, and sets up Yingchuan Commandery.

经过: 王翦破邯郸，虏赵王迁。
text_en: Wang Jian takes Handan and captures Qian, king of Zhao.

经过: 王贲引水灌大梁，魏王假降。
text_en: Wang Ben floods Daliang, and Jia, king of Wei, surrenders.

经过: 王翦、蒙武虏楚王负刍。
text_en: Wang Jian and Meng Wu capture Fuchu, king of Chu.

经过: 王贲虏燕王喜、代王嘉。
text_en: Wang Ben captures Xi, king of Yan, and Jia, king of Dai.

经过: 齐王建降，秦统一天下。
text_en: Jian, king of Qi, surrenders, and Qin unifies the realm.

经过: 秦二世废卫君角，卫绝祀。
text_en: The Second Emperor of Qin deposes Jue, lord of Wey, and the sacrifices of Wey come to an end.
